name: instagram-focus
description: An iOS app that loads Instagram with only messages and the useful parts — no home feed, no Reels, no Explore.

comments.playwright: Optional. The only shipped dependency, and only for tests: it runs the engine under WebKit, which is the browser family iOS actually uses. Without it `npm test` skips the WebKit tests rather than failing. Install with: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install webkit
